cohort: Complete Dynamize source through generic activation alternatives
notes: Pending native generic grant integration and source gameplay verification.

mechanics.original_reminder: A dynamized permanent may activate each of its nonloyalty abilities for free once each turn.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Give {Object} the dynamized status until end of turn. While {Object} has the dynamized status, you may pay {0} rather than pay the activation cost of each of its nonloyalty activated abilities once each turn.

rule_text.name: 701.107a
rule_text.rule: Dynamize is a keyword action that gives a permanent the "dynamized" designation for a duration. Once each turn, each of a dynamized permanent's activated abilities other than loyalty abilities may be activated by paying {0} rather than its activation cost.

rule_text.name: 701.107b
rule_text.rule: Dynamizing a permanent that is already dynamized is redundant.

rule_text.name: 701.107c
rule_text.rule: Abilities that would not normally not function on the battlefield still cannot be activated, even if their cost was the only thing preventing them from functioning.
